correctness.rationale: Direct differentiation gives \(\dot F=-b/4\) exactly, with all state terms canceling. Integration yields \(F(t)=F(0)-bt/4\). The exact polynomial computation was replayed from the packaged verifier. The \(b=0\) boundary and altered 2022 equations are explicitly excluded.
